description: Create a reusable OmniGuard KYC Verify template (anti-deepfake identity verification: active-illumination liveness, corneal-reflection anti face-swap, deepfake-injection/virtual-camera defence, server-authoritative signed verdicts). A template is a named config — the flow (face, or face+document), the ID type (nin/bvn/passport/ghana_card/drivers_license/voters_card/custom), the data source that backs the registry match (a Nemesis built-in source for NIN/BVN/passport/sanctions, or your own knowledge source), and which attributes must match (name/dob/gender/face/address). Then create a session against the template id to get a verification link. Auth: a developer key (dak_) or your OmniGuard ingest token.

flow.description: face = liveness + number; face+document = also capture the document (use for passport)

matchAttributes.description: Attributes that must match the registry

requireMobile.description: Require the user to complete on a mobile device

showResult.description: Show the verdict to the end-user (off = neutral 'submitted' screen)

token.description: Developer key (dak_…) or OmniGuard ingest token — used as a Bearer token

webhookUrl.description: HTTPS webhook to receive the signed result

name: nemesis_kyc_create_template
